name: Monitor Solid Waste Disposal
implementation_notes: Mirrors MonitorCagesTrackView.vue's structural pattern (breadcrumb + hamburger header, draft/pause list, New Data/Load Data/Back footer) but with EVENT-LOG summary semantics: 'Hari Ini' shows Jumlah Solid Waste Disposal + Jumlah Kejadian Tercatat (not a tipping-progress metric), plus a new 'Kejadian Terakhir' card (getLastEventSummary()) showing the single most-recently-logged event across ALL of the user's records (not scoped to today) — there is no meaningful 'progress toward N' metric for a free event log

localSchema.ts gained 2 new tables (solid_waste_disposal_record, solid_waste_disposal_detail) via CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS — no column-migration function needed since these are brand-new tables, not an existing-table schema change
router/index.ts gained 3 new routes: monitor-solid-waste-disposal, solid-waste-disposal-form, data-preview-solid-waste-disposal

StationListView.vue's draftStatusByType wiring updated: 'solid-waste-disposal' now calls solidWasteDisposalRecordRepo.getDrafts(userId).length > 0 instead of the previous hardcoded false placeholder — MONITOR_ROUTE_NAMES already had 'monitor-solid-waste-disposal' mapped from an earlier station-list update, so the tile itself needed no further changes

solidWasteDisposalRecordRepo.ts is a new, from-scratch repo file (no pre-existing block to extend) — createDraft()/getTodaySummary()/getLastEventSummary()/getDrafts()/getAllRecords()/getDraftWithDetails()/saveDraft()/pauseDraftWithFormData()/deleteDraft() all written together

known_issues.description: Browser/E2E test not generated for this pass (no Playwright infra wired into this sandbox run) — component-level (Vitest) coverage exercises the same navigation/business logic instead.
Unit test coverage % not measured — no Xdebug/PCOV in this environment, consistent with prior stations in this codebase.
